g.text: HBO Renews Sharon Horgan Comedy ‘Youth’ For a Season 2 ◆ Golden Globes Predictions: ‘The Odyssey’ Eyes Double Digits as Studios Flood the Comedy Races ◆ Roku Delivers Another Stellar Quarter: Q3 Sales Soar 24% as Media and Entertainment Ad Spending Sees Biggest Growth in Four Years ◆ ‘X-Men’: ‘Hunger Games’ Actor Ben Wang Circling Iceman Role in Marvel’s Reboot ◆ Jessica Alba Battled ‘Major Impostor Syndrome’ as She Built The Honest Company Into an Early Star-Led Business Success Story ◆ Meta to Help Bring ‘The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ to 3D Screens — and Its $1,299 VR Glasses ◆
